name: kidschinese-e2e-tests
description: End-to-end test with the Firebase emulators and the Kids Games rules. Needs Java 11 or later and Playwright.

scripts.e2e: node tests/copy-rules.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kidsgames --only auth,firestore --config firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/app.e2e.mjs"
